scope.q: What specific user actions or events define "setup completion" and where do users typically drop off in the existing funnel?
scope.why: Precisely defining success and identifying current drop-off points is critical to scope the problem and measure impact.

scope.q: What existing data sources, if any, track user behavior during setup, and what are their reliability and accessibility characteristics?
scope.why: Understanding available data, even if imperfect, dictates initial data strategy and potential for historical analysis.

scope.q: What are the top 2-3 most impactful product theories regarding signup drop-off that we should prioritize investigating?
scope.why: Focusing on key theories will ensure the solution directly addresses the most likely causes of the problem.

decomposition.title: Data Source Integration & Validation
decomposition.why: Establishing reliable access to all relevant user event data is fundamental before any analysis can begin.

decomposition.title: Funnel Definition & Baselines
decomposition.why: Clearly defining the setup funnel steps and measuring current conversion rates provides a baseline for improvement.

decomposition.title: Behavioral Analytics Engine
decomposition.why: A system to process and query user event data is necessary to identify patterns and test hypotheses.

decomposition.title: Hypothesis Testing & Insights Generation
decomposition.why: This piece focuses on using the data to validate product theories and uncover root causes for drop-offs.

decomposition.title: Dashboarding & Reporting
decomposition.why: Providing clear visualization of funnel performance and key metrics ensures ongoing monitoring and communication.

sprint.title: Define Setup Funnel & Event Schema
sprint.deliv: Documented definition of 'setup complete' and a proposed event schema for relevant user actions.

sprint.title: Integrate Core Event Data Sources
sprint.deliv: Working data pipeline ingesting raw user events from existing systems into a temporary datastore.

sprint.title: Build Funnel Analytics Queries
sprint.deliv: SQL queries or scripts to calculate conversion rates for each step of the defined setup funnel.

sprint.title: Initial Dashboard & Baseline Metrics
sprint.deliv: Interactive dashboard showing current signup funnel performance and key drop-off points, with an established baseline.

sprint.title: Hypothesis Validation & Initial Insights
sprint.deliv: Report on the validity of 1-2 product theories based on the new data, with specific evidence or counter-evidence.

risks.risk: Existing instrumentation is too sparse or incorrect to reconstruct a reliable historical setup funnel.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize implementing new, robust event tracking for critical steps, acknowledging historical data limitations for early analysis.

risks.risk: Product team's theories are vague or untestable with quantitative data.
risks.mitigation: Work closely with Product to refine theories into testable hypotheses with measurable metrics before data collection and analysis.

risks.risk: Data privacy or security concerns complicate accessing or processing user behavior data.
risks.mitigation: Engage legal/security teams early to ensure compliance, potentially working with anonymized or aggregated data initially.

risks.risk: Technical debt in existing systems makes data extraction or integration unexpectedly difficult and time-consuming.
risks.mitigation: Start with high-priority, known-good data sources and progressively integrate others, clearly documenting blockers and dependencies.
